card: Suppresses echoing user-supplied passwords in plain-text terminal output from `share/rpcauth/rpcauth.py`. Previously, passwords supplied via positional arguments or hidden prompts were printed back to standard output, unnecessarily exposing credentials to terminal scrollback. Passwords randomly generated by the tool continue to be displayed, and machine-readable JSON output remains unchanged.
evidence: Author notes: "Printing a user-supplied password again exposes a secret without any benefit. This is especially unnecessary in getpass mode: the password is entered hidden, then printed to the screen." (PR description)
problem: `rpcauth.py` prints user-supplied passwords back to standard output in plain text. When users input a password via a hidden prompt (`getpass`), the utility exposes the secret to terminal history and shoulder surfers without utility.

risk.why: A bug could misformat or suppress generated credentials when users run the rpcauth helper script.

summary: Updates `share/rpcauth/rpcauth.py` to omit user-supplied passwords from human-readable CLI output, displaying the password only when it was automatically generated by the script. JSON output formatting is left unchanged, and functional tests covering the CLI output are added.
